name: Takenashi Shizuka
source:
Sommelier.

He has a gifted sense of smell and taste, and never forgets the flavor of something he tastes once.
He has sharp eyes but doesn't care much about the world around him.
A bit of a troublesome person.

He has a surprisingly mischievous side.
